5411-5531-6621-8345.easyPrerequisites: Other lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{C}.
5411-5531-6621-8345.description:
Activate any number of other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{C}.
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing a land except Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands except Mirrorpool.
Activate Mirrorpool's third ability by paying {4}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, creating a token copy of Lumra.
Put the Lumra token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
Repeat.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

2438-4550-5567-8298--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
2438-4550-5567-8298--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

1385-1981-2415-8227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
1385-1981-2415-8227.description:
Activate Loot by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Zulaport Cutthroat and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Loot's ability, giving them -2/-0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

643-997-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
643-997-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat from step 3.

6798-7690-8181--165.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another creature, causing you to surveil 1
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

4419-4694-5147-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
4419-4694-5147-7306.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Renata.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to its target.
Repeat from step 1.

3197-6495-6872.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
3197-6495-6872.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Long Feng triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat from step 3.
3197-6495-6872.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

240-4247-5470-7730.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

101-1987-6259.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
101-1987-6259.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Vampire Charmseeker.
When Vampire Charmseeker enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
101-1987-6259.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

1491-4474-6218-7741.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

2341-2495-7685.description:
Activate Tezzeret's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, targeting Arc Reactor and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Holding priority, activate Arc Reactor by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}
Activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Tezzeret's ability, targeting Arc Reactor and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Resolve the copy of Tezzeret's ability, untapping Arc Reactor and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Repeat from step 2.

3372-4050-6006-7297.manaNeeded: {1}{W} if Enduring Vitality is not a creature
3372-4050-6006-7297.description:
If Enduring Vitality is not a creature, activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Enduring Vitality to become a creature.
Activate Enduring Vitality by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar's second ability by sacrificing Enduring Vitality, adding {1}.
When Enduring Vitality dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as an enchantment.
Repeat.

296-3532-5078-6709.easyPrerequisites:
There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
Ballad of the Black Flag's fourth chapter ability has triggered this turn
296-3532-5078-6709.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
The Thirteenth Doctor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

967-3129-3809-5256-7087.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

955-1170-1329-2478.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard.
Cast Mishra's Bauble by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

2530-2577-4268-6518.easyPrerequisites: You control another Zombie if Gravecrawler is in your graveyard.
2530-2577-4268-6518.description:
Cast Gravecrawler either from your hand or graveyard by paying {B}.
When Gravecrawler enters the battlefield, Kor Celebrant, Carnival of Souls and The Sibsig Ceremony trigger.
Resolve the Kor Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B}.
Resolve the Sibsig Ceremony trigger, destroying Gravecrawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When the Zombie Druid enters the battlefield, Kor Celebrant and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Kor Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B}.
Repeat.

687-4669-4929-5641-5684.notablePrerequisites: If Hajar is in your graveyard, you must have {3} available and three removable counters from creatures you control, ensuring to leave a +1/+1 counter on Cryptic Trilobite and Basking Broodscale. If Hajar is in your hand, you must have enough mana to cast it.
687-4669-4929-5641-5684.description:
Cast Hajar by paying its mana cost if it is in your hand. Otherwise, activate Tayam by paying {3} and removing three counters from creatures you control, causing you to mill three cards and return Hajar from your graveyard to the battlefield with a vigilance counter on it.
When Hajar enters the battlefield, Metastatic Evangel triggers, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on Cryptic Trilobite and Basking Broodscale and a vigilance counter on Hajar.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that enters with a vigilance counter on it.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Activate Tayam by paying {3}, removing both vigilance counters from Hajar and another counter from a creature you control.
Holding priority, activate Hajar by sacrificing it.
Resolve the Tayam ability, causing you to mill three cards and return Hajar from your graveyard to the battlefield with a vigilance counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.
Repeat.
687-4669-4929-5641-5684.notes: If you do not control any other creatures, you may instead activate Tayam before sacrificing the Eldrazi Spawn, thus using the Eldrazi Spawn's vigilance counter as the third counter for activation. Doing this will add {1} to the mana needed for the combo.

1238-2351-4452-5467-5686.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Heart of Kiran by tapping Wylie Duke.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the Tentacle.
When the Tentacle dies, The Watcher's second ability triggers, untapping Wylie Duke and putting a stun counter on up to one permanent.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Repeat.

4125-4377-5626.manaNeeded: {4}{U}{U} the first turn, with {6}{U}{U}{B}{B} each extra turn
4125-4377-5626.notablePrerequisites:
You control a nontoken creature with mana value 1 or less.
You have at least {E}{E}.
4125-4377-5626.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}{E}{E}, sacrificing a creature with mana value 1 or less, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Shipwreck Dowser from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying at most {E}, sacrificing Shipwreck Dowser, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning a creature with mana value 1 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

791-3693-4522-5426.notablePrerequisites:
Quest for Pure Flame has at least four quest counters on it.
You have a way to give Walking Ballista lifelink.
Walking Ballista has at least two +1/+1 counters on it, or your life total is at least 4.
791-3693-4522-5426.description:
Activate Quest for Pure Flame by removing four quest counters from it and sacrificing it, doubling all damage dealt by sources you control this turn.
Cast Insult by paying {2}{R}, doubling all damage dealt by sources you control this turn.
Give Walking Ballista lifelink, if needed.
If Walking Ballista has less than two +1/+1 counters on it, activate Unspeakable Symbol by paying 3 life, putting a +1/+1 counter on Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 4 damage to an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls, and causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat from step 4.

1819-4797-5509-5510.notablePrerequisites:
You have a number of copies of Rat Colony in your library greater than your maximum hand size minus the number of cards in your hand.
Tormod's Cryptkeeper does not have summoning sickness.
1819-4797-5509-5510.description:
Cast Secret Salvage by paying {3}{B}{B}, exiling Rat Colony from your graveyard and causing you to search your library for all copies of Rat Colony in your library and put them into your hand.
Syr Konrad triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Move to your cleanup step, causing you to discard down to your maximum hand size, ensuring to discard as many copies of Rat Colony as possible.
Syr Konrad triggers for each creature card discarded this way, dealing that much damage to each opponent.
Activate Tormod's Cryptkeeper by tapping and sacrificing it.
When Tormod's Cryptkeeper dies, Syr Konrad triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Tormod's Cryptkeeper ability, exiling your graveyard.
Syr Konrad triggers for each creature card exiled this way, dealing that much damage to each opponent.

275-1799-4242-5256.notablePrerequisites: Grenzo has a power of four or greater.
275-1799-4242-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Su-Chi.
When Su-Chi dies, it triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Su-Chi's power.
Activate Transplant Theorist by paying {2}, putting Su-Chi on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Su-Chi into your graveyard from the bottom of your library, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

3484-3487-4374.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two energy counters.
3484-3487-4374.description:
Activate Aethergeode Miner by paying {E}{E}, blinking it.
Aethergeode Miner enters the battlefield, triggering Aetherstorm Roc and Decoction Module, causing you to get {E}{E}.
Repeat.

2470-2645-4694.description:
Activate Grand Architect's first ability by paying {U}, causing Staff of Domination to become blue until end of turn.
Activate Grand Architect's second ability by tapping Staff of Domination, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to cast artifact spells or to activate abilities of artifacts.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead tap Staff of Domination using its other abilities if it does not have summoning sickness.

1430-1525-2031-2406-2660.notablePrerequisites:
Mirror Image is a copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Wheel of Sun and Moon attached to you.
1430-1525-2031-2406-2660.description:
Cast Lightning Storm by paying {1}{R}{R}, targeting either copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Stormchaser Drake triggers, which due to Abundance causes you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card and put it into your hand.
Activate Lightning Storm by discarding a land card, putting that land card on the bottom of your library due to Wheel of Sun and Moon.
Resolve the Lightning Storm ability, putting two charge counters on it and changing the target to the other copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Repeat from step 2.
Once Lightning Storm has an arbitrarily large number of charge counters, activate it by discarding a land to change its target to any other target of your choosing to deal infinite damage to that target.
1430-1525-2031-2406-2660.notes: Other players may also activate Lightning Storm to change its target, making this combo risky if you do not have additional land cards in hand to activate Lightning Storm again.

3492-3609-5003.notablePrerequisites: Coretapper does not have summoning sickness.
3492-3609-5003.description:
Activate Coretapper's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Coretapper's second ability by sacrificing it.
Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Coretapper from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve Coretapper's ability, putting two charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, taking an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2103-3229-4423.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three additional Islands.
2103-3229-4423.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}, getting an extra turn after this one.
Play Mystic Sanctuary to put Capture of Jingzhou on top of your library.
Activate Kefnet the Mindful by paying {3}{U}, causing you to draw a card and returning Mystic Sanctuary to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat.

364-1283-1987-3227.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first activated ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {C}, targeting Chromatic Orrery and Scrivener, blinking them.
When Scrivener enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Chromatic Orrery's last ability any number of times.
